identity.name: Static Fork
identity.summary: A two tined copper tuning fork with a dark cork grip.
identity.description: Costs 1 mana per activation. Deals 4 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 1 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: It answers distant thunder before the clouds arrive.

effects.description: Costs 1 mana per activation. Deals 4 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 1 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its lightning trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

visual.brief: A two tined copper tuning fork with a dark cork grip.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A two tined copper tuning fork with a dark cork grip.
